svg.title: cantilever sliding preview
svg.desc: 4000 mm opening · 1000 mm high · traditional victorian · Black satin. Figma CAD silhouette — no baked millimetres on the drawing. CA-05: typed width = clear opening only. Seed example: opening 4000 mm → min tail 1333 mm → min parking run 5333 mm. Leaf fills 100% of the clear opening between posts. Triangular counterbalance sits AFTER the parking/guide post — never inside the opening.
